nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file that re-exports the session store's types, atoms, loaders, mutations, helpers, and pagination atoms to preserve the original sessionAtom public API.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript barrel using `export * from` re-exports of sibling modules.

nodes.name: sessionTabPlacementAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai action atoms that move or retarget a session's chat tab between the Chat Panel and the Workstation, ensuring only one visible owner shows a given session at a time.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the SessionViewState interface describing the persisted single-session view state (active session ID, display name, repo path).

nodes.name: viewAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the two-atom session selection model, a persisted WorkStation memory atom and a transient pipeline atom, plus the canonical open/close/jump actions used across the app to switch the active session.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses atomWithStorage with a Zod schema transform to persist session view state while forcing activeSessionId to null on reload (startup-must-be-inert rule).

nodes.name: visitedSessionsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks which session IDs the user has opened, backing the sidebar's unread-dot badge and the Kanban 'Completed: Unread' column, with an LRU-capped localStorage-backed list.

nodes.name: markSessionVisited
nodes.summary: Marks a session as visited, promoting it to the front of the visited-IDs list (idempotent no-op if already at the head) and enforcing the MAX_VISITED_IDS cap.

nodes.name: markAllSessionsVisited
nodes.summary: Marks a batch of session IDs as visited in a single store write, used by the sidebar's 'Mark All Read' action to clear multiple unread badges in one render pass.
